items.text: To use your college placement and career cell well, register early, learn the process and eligibility rules, attend preparation sessions, keep documents ready, follow up politely and also search outside campus drives, because the cell helps but does not guarantee an offer.
Ask how they are counted and never pay for placement outside official fees.
high income opportunities come from finished work in one lane.
